# Deutsche Welle (DW)

> DW is Germany's international broadcaster covering global news, politics, economics, and culture with focus on Middle Eastern conflicts, European politics, and technology.

Deutsche Welle provides comprehensive coverage of international affairs with particular emphasis on the Iran conflict, German politics and elections, banking sector developments, and emerging technologies like AI. The site serves a global German-speaking and English-speaking audience with in-depth analysis and breaking news.

## Key Topics

- Iran conflict
- Iran-USA military tensions
- Middle East escalation
- German politics
- Baden-Württemberg election
- Cem Özdemir
- Banking mergers
- UniCredit-Commerzbank acquisition
- Industrial AI
- NATO security
- Healthcare crisis
- BRICS alliance
- Turkey regional concerns
- Ballistic missiles
- Global economics

## Iran Conflict & Middle East

- [Iran-Krieg: Chronisch Kranke kämpfen ums Überleben](https://www.dw.com/de/iran-krieg-chronisch-kranke-fehlende-medikamente-%C3%A4rzte-versorgung-kliniken-operationen/a-76381037): Iran's humanitarian crisis: chronic patients face medication shortages and healthcare collapse.
- [Türkei im Iran-Krieg: Angst vor dem Flächenbrand](https://www.dw.com/de/t%C3%BCrkei-im-iran-krieg-angst-vor-dem-fl%C3%A4chenbrand/a-76230053): Turkey fears regional escalation, Kurdish resurgence, and refugee influx from Iran conflict.
- [Können die USA ihre militärischen Ziele im Iran erreichen?](https://www.dw.com/de/k%C3%B6nnen-die-usa-ihre-milit%C3%A4rischen-ziele-im-iran-erreichen/a-76167812): Analysis of US military objectives against Iran's nuclear program and missiles.
- [Wie lange kann der Iran einen Krieg logistisch durchhalten?](https://www.dw.com/de/wie-lange-kann-der-iran-einen-krieg-logistisch-durchhalten/a-76214303): Iran's military logistics and sustainability in conflict with US and Israel.
- [Iran-Krieg: Bruchlinien innerhalb der BRICS-Allianz](https://www.dw.com/de/bricsstaaten-allianz-druck-iran-krieg-indien-deeskalation-handel-wirtschaft-chamenei-modi-teheran/a-76441573): BRICS alliance fractures over Iran conflict response under India's 2026 presidency.
- [ARD-Deutschlandtrend: Mehrheit lehnt Angriff auf Iran ab](https://www.dw.com/de/ard-deutschlandtrend-mehrheit-lehnt-angriff-auf-iran-ab/a-76236592): German poll: three-quarters feel threatened by global situation; reject Iran strikes.
- [News kompakt: Trump will Teile der US-Ölreserven freigeben](https://www.dw.com/de/iran-krieg-%C3%B6lreserve-donald-trump-g7-geleitschutz-golf-johann-wadephul-lufthansa-piloten-streik-merz/a-76316753): Trump releases US oil reserves; Lufthansa pilot strike impacts travel.
